rows.title: Nested space and anchor settlement
rows.preserve: Name the independently acquired nested-space source and its exact entry/anchor/ending contract. Resolve whether it ends with children settled before parent or survives with a source-authorized relocated/settled entrance. Bind parent/child IDs, anchors, all contents and independent costs/deadlines. The preserved Wizard20 has Dimensional Pocket/Arcane Sanctuary capabilities, but availability alone does not authorize a surviving anchor relocation. If that contract is absent, retain this exact interface hold; do not delete, copy, relocate or make the child eternal by assumption.
rows.remainingPredicate: A selected and paid child instance with exact entry/anchor/contents/independent deadlines and a complete legal terminal ordering. A still-surviving child’s parent-loss/anchor disposition remains source-interface held; the sources reviewed do not authorize relocating it by assumption.
rows.sourceFactsAlreadyAvailable: PG200-W20 already has Demiplane acquired/prepared. The accepted model provides a persistent room, finite door, fixed anchors and true-room ending/P5-CLOSE; PG9-Q27/Q29 supply parent settlement order. Closing a door does not end the child room, and generic parent cleanup cannot relocate a surviving child.
rows.nextAction: Build the existing-source ended-child branch first: paid Demiplane inside Fortress; legal interior perception and actual true-room Arch Dispel at rank8/DC18; apply P5-CLOSE while parent still exists; then separately paid Fortress Dispel at DC19. Submit the explicit W13 coverage decision with that branch. Do not call a door closure a room ending or claim surviving-anchor coverage.

proposedOwnerTerms.scope: PG328-W13 only; independent hypothetical TEST_ONLY branch; no campaign occurrence
terms: PROPOSED ONLY: nominate this exact parent/child pair and stable anchors, finite contents and source-legal actor scene; owner adopts deterministic encounter inputs and the decision to end the child first. The child’s actual paid source operation, not a premise, must cause its ending.

Bind every child return into the still-live parent before parent closure; then settle parent returns once. Preserve the child’s independent costs, source ID, door deadline, persistent-room status, property and history.

If the review instead requires the child to remain operative at parent loss, obtain the exact source-authorized survival/anchor contract. An owner-authored new paired interface would require separate explicit mechanics authorization and review, not just scene adoption; none is proposed as adopted here.

No automatic child death, parent-triggered child ending, anchor relocation, duplicate cargo or eternalization is authorized by this crosswalk. Whether the executed ended-child branch suffices for the retained W13 obligation must be expressly decided; no obligation is revised now.

rows.sourcePermissionStillNeeded: For a surviving-child branch only, explicit parent-loss/anchor permission is still absent. A source-authorized ended-child branch can be constructed now.

recommendedNextAction: One new independent W05→W10 creator-death/corpse-return branch from the preserved W01-403 parent, after narrow hypothetical choices/body-placement premises are adopted. This reuses existing acquired attack/perception/Dispel sources and can support two explicit component decisions. W04 and W12 are also constructible with bounded physical/scene premises. W11 needs an acquired compatible carrier/cargo record; W13 needs the chosen child-ending contract and cannot assume surviving-anchor relocation.

Separate owner-adopted hypothetical scene choices from existing source mechanics and from any new proposed rule.
Source-bound acquisition/preparation/current resources, components, action/command budgets, counter windows, recharge, Dissonance/Refrain and actual original clocks.

No incidental rest, refill, revival, deadline reset, duplicate entity or erased history. New damage/death/geometry must follow the actual source outcomes.
Review each successor for its named component only; no whole-identity acceptance inferred from an audit or component PASS.
